snippet.title: BloomKeeper - Release Date Announcement Trailer 🌿
snippet.description:
🌿 BloomKeeper will launch on September 16, 2026 🌿 The world of Hedera is waiting for you ✨

👉🏻 Wishlist the game : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3034650/BloomKeeper/

*** 

🌱  Welcome to BloomKeeper, a real-time tactical, poetic adventure where you play as a Guardian trying to bring nature back to life in Hedera.

🎮 Demo out now on Steam!
👥 Play Solo or Co-op with up to 4 players
📍 Made with love in Montpellier, France by a small indie team

Follow us on social media :

Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/bloomkeeper_ri/
Tiktok :  https://www.tiktok.com/@bloomkeeper_ri
X (twitter) : https://x.com/bloomkeeper_ri
Linkedin :  https://fr.linkedin.com/company/resonance-interactive
Twitch : https://www.twitch.tv/resonance_interactive

💬 Join our discord: https://discord.gg/4MVFc4K4BG

🌐 Visit our website: https://resonance-interactive.com/bloomkeeper/
